spans.text: The Red Manor is an underground organization broken up into many largely unrelated cells, all united solely by their worship of Invidia. They are willing to work together, but often have guild-like units that prefer to work independently. Despite Invidia’s chaotic neutral existence, this indulgent organization is truly evil in nature: their agents are assassins and cut-throats who will work for coin, or at the behest of their goddess. They take great pride in their efficacy as killers.
